name: mawah-academy
description: MAWAH Academy — premium bilingual online cooking & baking course platform on Cloudflare Workers (Hono), D1, KV, R2 and Stream.

scripts.build: npm run build:marketing && npm run build:app && npm run build:admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w worker && npm run typecheck -w app && npm run typecheck -w admin
scripts.test: npm run check:i18n && npm run build:marketing && npm run test -w worker
scripts.db:migrate:local: npm run build:marketing && npm run db:migrate:local -w worker
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w worker
